ja: アウトサイドヒーロー
decisions.note: Locator 1300051 verifies the English-styled JP title アウトサイドヒーロー; preserve it as Outside Hero instead of calquing the Chinese wording.
Locator 200612 verifies JP 外差し準備, the standard skill for preparing an outside overtake; the Vietnamese label is compact and mechanic-faithful.
Locator 203881 verifies JP 問答無用; Miễn bàn cãi preserves the concise idiomatic force without following the Chinese wording literally.
Locator 202233 verifies JP ナイター× and its night-race condition; retain the × grade marker.
Locator 202232 verifies JP ナイター○ and its night-race condition; retain the ○ grade marker.
Locator 202231 verifies JP ナイター◎ and its night-race condition; retain the ◎ grade marker.
Locator 200953 verifies JP 大井レース場×; use the Roman place name Oi and preserve the × marker.
Locator 200952 verifies JP 大井レース場○; use the Roman place name Oi and preserve the ○ marker.
Locator 200951 verifies JP 大井レース場◎; use the Roman place name Oi and preserve the ◎ marker.
Locator 101101111 verifies JP 大和撫子; preserve the established cultural expression Yamato Nadeshiko rather than a literal Chinese-name calque.
Locator 105701211 maps to JP 弾む大地; the poetic verb supports multiple natural Vietnamese renderings and no repository mapping establishes one.
Locator 210281 verifies JP 大地の叡智, but its Vietnamese rendering should be normalized together with the sibling 太陽の叡智 / 大海の叡智 terminology family.
Locator 110002111 maps to JP 大地轟く大噴湯; the hot-spring wordplay/poetic title needs contextual rendering rather than a literal Chinese calque.
Locator 201431 verifies JP 大局観 and the skill widens race vision; Tầm nhìn toàn cục is concise and mechanic-consistent.
Public JP game references verify マスターズドライブ as the Masters Challenge special skill; preserve the English-styled title instead of the Chinese semantic calque.
Locator 200982 verifies JP 大きなリード; Dẫn trước xa is a compact Vietnamese rendering of the race-state concept.
